mitre.technique_name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: AS-REP Roasting

description: Adversaries may reveal credentials of accounts that have disabled Kerberos preauthentication by Password Cracking Kerberos messages. Preauthentication offers protection against offline password cracking. When enabled, a user requesting access to a resource initiates communication with the Domain Controller (DC) by sending an Authentication Server Request (AS-REQ) message with a timestamp that is encrypted with the hash of their password.
artifacts: LDAP queries (TCP/389, TCP/636) filtering on userAccountControl bit DONT_REQ_PREAUTH (0x400000)
LDAP search requests for accounts with Kerberos preauthentication disabled
Kerberos AS-REQ requests (TCP/88, UDP/88) without preauthentication data (PA-ENC-TIMESTAMP absent)
Kerberos AS-REP responses containing RC4-HMAC (etype 23) encrypted material for offline cracking
KRB_ERROR responses (KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_REQUIRED or KDC_ERR_C_PRINCIPAL_UNKNOWN) for invalid attempts
Multiple sequential AS-REQ requests for different usernames from the same source
AS-REQ with kdc-options flags indicating no preauth and targeting user principals

pcaps.name: Internal AS-REP roasting (netexec LDAP)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated AS-REP roasting using netexec LDAP module showing enumeration of DONT_REQ_PREAUTH accounts via LDAP and Kerberos AS-REQ/AS-REP exchanges with the domain controller.

pcaps.name: Internal AS-REP roasting (impacket GetNPUsers, authenticated)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated AS-REP roasting using impacket GetNPUsers.py showing enumeration of DONT_REQ_PREAUTH accounts via LDAP and Kerberos AS-REQ/AS-REP exchanges with the domain controller.

pcaps.name: Internal AS-REP roasting succeeded (impacket GetNPUsers, unauthenticated)
pcaps.description: Internal unauthenticated AS-REP roasting using impacket GetNPUsers.py with a valid DONT_REQ_PREAUTH username, showing Kerberos AS-REQ without preauth and AS-REP response containing crackable material.

pcaps.name: Internal AS-REP roasting failed (impacket GetNPUsers, unauthenticated)
pcaps.description: Internal unauthenticated AS-REP roasting attempt using impacket GetNPUsers.py against accounts without DONT_REQ_PREAUTH or with invalid usernames, showing Kerberos AS-REQ and KRB_ERROR responses from the domain controller.
